title: Hub cascade: DFW ground stop
description: A two-hour ground stop at DFW (thunderstorms). Airports with heavy DFW service get a hub cascade note for the 1–4 hours after it: Austin (low clouds, Low) goes up one step to Moderate; Houston and Minneapolis (quiet) go to Low. Nothing becomes "Delays happening now" there, and Seattle (no DFW in its top routes) gets nothing. A calendar trip MSP→DFW leaving after the ground stop ends shows the specific knock-on concern.
